northStar: risk-adjusted cleared contribution profit / founder minute

champion.name: White-label Attribution Integrity + Lost-Booking Evidence Sprint
champion.why: It is the only contender with a bounded read-only scope, a fixed first-payment hypothesis, a one-to-many agency channel, and no required customer-system mutation. This is a model prior, not demand or payment evidence.

canary.killRule: No paid pilot after five qualified conversations means kill or rethink before volume expansion.
canary.deliveryBoundary: Read-only evidence; no advertising, CRM, booking, payment, or customer-system mutation.

capabilityCorpus.truth: DISCOVERED metadata is not a normalized capability, security admission, installation, benchmark, or production use.

modelGateway.invariant: Preserve exact model/provider/attempt/credential identity; no automatic system-credit fallback until the existing routing and spend policy explicitly permits it.

paypal.invariant: A provider account, verified merchant eligibility, provider verification, and canonical reconciliation are all required before revenue is claimed.

nextCommercialMove.action: After sender authentication, physical footer address, and suppression ledger are verified, use the approved public business routes for at most five bespoke partner conversations.
